violations.description: Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee's single-use gloves were not discarded after being damaged or soiled. Observed employee not changing gloves after handling raw beef/pork.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperature Ground beef stored next to chicken and whole muscle pork stored next to whole muscle beef in walk in cooler.--Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. Cooked chicken and mashed potatoes stored next to whole muscle pork in walk in cooler.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food prepared and packaged by a processing plant was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days after original package was opened. Ensure Mrs. Gerry's salads are dated with date product was opened.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Lower shelving units and equipment tops have build up of debris and dust and need cleaning. Reach in freezers have build up of breading crumbs and need cleaning.
Person in charge. — --- Certified food service manager had an expired certificate.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Food in walk in cooler and refrigerator not labeled and date marked.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as needed. - Reach-in coolers and freezers in need of cleaning. Food crumbs collecting below shelves.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Observed most items in walk in cooler and refrigerator were not date marked.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Observed towel under griddle that is not a cleanable surface.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Observed nozzles on soda dispenser needs to be cleaned.
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
